presets.name: Package registries
presets.description: Install packages from npm, PyPI, crates.io, Maven Central and RubyGems; never a publish. They stay open after a private read: they serve only their own files.

registryHosts.reason: npm's registry: package documents and tarballs are files npm stores, by package name; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
PyPI's index (simple and JSON APIs): pages PyPI builds from its own database, by project name; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
PyPI's file store: distributions PyPI holds, by content path; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
The Rust registry's API and download redirects, by crate name and version, from its own database; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
The Rust sparse index: files crates.io publishes, by crate name; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
The Rust crate file store: archives crates.io holds, by crate name and version; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
Maven Central: artifacts Sonatype stores, by group, artifact and version path; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
Maven Central's Apache name: the same store as repo1.maven.org; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
RubyGems' API and gem files, by gem name, from its own storage; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
RubyGems' compact index for Bundler: files RubyGems publishes, by gem name; it fetches nothing on a request's behalf.
